subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw replace the current native List-based iOS Control hub with this flatter card-based Chat/Talk-focused direction after the branch is rebased and proven?
rationale: The code change is a visible default iOS product direction choice, and the linked feature issue already marks the work as needing maintainer review/product decision; automation cannot decide the visual direction.

options.title: Rebase and review the card direction
options.body: Require a rebase over current main, branded typography, and simulator before/after proof before deciding whether to land the new Control tab layout.

options.title: Keep the current native List direction
options.body: Close or supersede this PR if maintainers prefer the current native iOS Control surface from the merged redesign work.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review the card direction
recommendation.body: Require a rebase over current main, branded typography, and simulator before/after proof before deciding whether to land the new Control tab layout.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Control/Talk visual hierarchy work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the visual direction decision.
